catchment.continuous_geometry: fixed side-wall box over the original tray footprint; the original tray bottom is retained
catchment.material_purpose: external rigid spill/overflow collection walls; mkbound=3 is a new physical material region
catchment.floor_purpose: original registered tray bottom, mkbound=2, retained as the collection floor
catchment.wall_thickness_semantics: numerical particle shell only; continuous physical boundary is the declared source plane

floor.surface_basis: source boxfill=bottom plane; source size z is not a top face

catchment_wall_spec.qualification_effect: new physical geometry scope; no inherited qualification

source_geometry_contract.fluid_initial_state: exact v3 full-cup native lattice and fixed continuous volume; static predecessor is hash-bound
source_geometry_contract.cup: passed full-cup v3 finite moving cup, unchanged
source_geometry_contract.tray_floor: registered boxfill=bottom tray floor mkbound=2 retained at source plane z=-0.20 m
source_geometry_contract.catchment_side_walls: new fixed mkbound=3 left/right/front/back walls over the tray footprint; top remains open
source_geometry_contract.motion: prescribed centered rotation, y axis through z=0.65, q=0.5 duration 0.85 s, unchanged control family

wall_audit_contract.ownership: open-top ownership is separate; side entry and recontact cannot be hidden by ownership

fixed_physical_case.sampling_rule: continuous fluid box exactly matches the cup interior faces; native sampling uses a separately declared inset lattice, native rho*dp^3, no rescaling
fixed_physical_case.control_semantics: prescribed centered rotation starts at 0.50 s; DBC uses the native mvrotfile rigid-body motion

fixed_recipe.geometry_contract: full-cup side-wet initial continuum box, retained cup/receiver/tray floor, four fixed catchment walls, top open
fixed_recipe.continuous_surface_contract: catchment floor is the retained tray boxfill=bottom source plane z=-0.20 m; wall shell thickness is numerical only
fixed_recipe.initial_mass_policy: native rho*dp^3 with no mass rescaling

event_window.right_censor_policy: 5 s is the registered qualification window; a right-censored required event fails the cell and no further extension is permitted

events.definition: prescribed cup angle reaches -105 degrees at 0.50 + duration(q) s
valid native fluid mass inside the one-dp-clear receiver interior first reaches 1% of initial fluid mass
valid native fluid mass outside the cup, receiver and tray observation volumes first reaches 1% of initial mass; missing identities remain a separate integrity failure
after motion completion, speed p95 <= 0.10 m/s and kinetic energy <= 5% of initial gravitational potential for 0.20 s continuously
motion, receiver contact and settled are observed, with 0.35 s of saved output after the last required transition

observer.geometry: moving cup body frame plus world receiver/tray/catchment; destination spill remains observable
observer.normalization: fixed initial-native-mass denominator; no survivor renormalization
